status: exploratory offline controls locked before R1 score

windows.stress: all T01..T16 historical mobile HOLD/PLACE windows, never score as standing Reach

inputs: end and start of last consumed reference
simultaneous two-view RGB estimate and calibration
no object truth or teacher vector in proposal

profiles.SHORT: first 0.50s inclusive, reanchor, one scalar bounds displacement to 20 mm from consumed pose; same scalar on rotation log
profiles.PROJECT: same prefix and scale. Euclidean projection on capped cylinder about RGB-derived preapproach (object center + 80 mm world vertical). Keep only supported forward component, clamp transverse radius using uncertainty. Limit orientation to 2 degrees. Reject outputs with no positive progress.
profiles.GEOMETRY: same visual target, uncertainty and constraints; smooth 20 mm line; no SLA input

uncertainty: Development allowance 5 mm (rounded up from pre-existing initial 4.08/3.84 mm), plus half ray separation. Reject if >=8 mm, rejected/missing triangulation or image component touches border, including stress rows. This is a design allowance, not a validated confidence interval.
reach_grip: registered open only; no synthesized gripper events. Archived non-Reach grip and phase are not tested.
readouts: all source knot positions and rotations relative to previous command
prefix fraction and difference from matched SLA increments
size of orientation and lateral correction
whole candidate versus held-out task axis, actual object distance for 3 standing returns
frozen H40 including incoming seam and two-object safety sweep on standing preview wherever applicable
scores: Offline candidate geometry and gate checks only. A proposal on a subsequent observed state is a local counterfactual, not a trajectory executed by the robot. No selection by best window, no native starts.
